main_text.p: At quid nos ilta moramur? Agedum : Coeant in vnum Pontificij doctores: Conueniant inter se de situ sui Purgatorij, de cruciatibus, de subiecto, de duratione, de tortoribus, de animarum inibi detentarum conditione : & dein noftrum post-illâ assensum praestolentur : Interea temporis, quin liberum nobis sit cum Suarez vagis defunctorum manibus non credere nisi metaphoricè; & non minus Purgatorium illud plebeium denegare, quàm Bellarmino aliud nouum admittere nobile ac senatorium.Tom. 4. in Thu. d. 46.Bellar. de Purg. l. 2. c. 7.

page.notes: Marginal notes read "Tom.4. in Tho. d.46." and "Bellar. de Purg. l.2.c.7." Some letters in the notes are blurred; the spelling "Tom.4." and "Tho." is uncertain. The word "Agedum" and the marginal reference "Tho." may be misread.
